description.p: Kara Download Manager splits each download into parallel connections, resumes interrupted transfers and catches downloads and videos straight from your browser through the Kara DM extension (Firefox, Chrome, Chromium). It also works with the Neat Download Manager browser extension.

ul.li: Up to 16 connections per file with a live segment bar
Resume after restarts and network drops
HLS and DASH video streams (yt-dlp, ffmpeg)
Categories, speed limit and concurrent download limit

description.p: First public release: Linux (Flatpak) and Windows builds, new logo, Kara DM browser extension.
